name: Shitsu Rakuen Karuta
source:
"The one who came to greet me in my final moments was a pure white grim reaper..."
She speaks of ancient tales akin to the Arabian Nights.

The protagonist, Shatarou, suffers from insomnia, spending each night unable to sleep. Suddenly, a pure white girl, a 'shinigami,' appears before him. She promises to tell him ancient tales every night until he can fall asleep again... But these tales reveal the sins and punishments he has committed.

Until his anger subsides, she continues to speak.
Until his sins are purified, until this body is cleansed...
Until "you" can forgive him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519630]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“在我最后时刻迎接我的，是一只纯白的死神……”
她谈到了类似于天方夜谭的古老故事。

主人公斜太郎患有失眠症，每晚都无法入睡。突然，一个纯白的少女，也就是“死神”，出现在了他的面前。她答应每天晚上给他讲古老的故事，直到他再次入睡……但这些故事揭示了他所犯下的罪恶和惩罚。

直到他的怒气消退，她才继续说话。
直到他的罪孽被净化，直到这个身体被净化……
直到“你”能够原谅他。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519630]Steam[/url]]
